<Frame><img src="https://chat.youniverse.ai/__l5e/assets-v1/eb58d751-dd03-48e8-9874-9197b35003aa/docs-studio-library.jpg" alt="Glass media library containing artwork, film and audio" /></Frame>

**AI Studio → Media** brings generated files into one library. Individual workspaces also provide their own history, so you can return to a song, speech generation or Imagine result without starting over.

## Where to look
| Surface | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Imagine Explore | Browse finished Imagine work. |
| Imagine History | Search and revisit generations, including their original settings. |
| Speech History | Reopen narration generated in Speech. |
| Music | Return to your tracks and their editing tools. |
| Media | Browse generated creative files together. |

## Reuse previous work
Use **Remix** where available to return to a generation's settings. Use previous images as references for another image, video or lip-sync task. Reusing a file does not guarantee the model will reproduce it exactly.

## Generation status
Creative jobs can take time. Check whether a job is pending, processing, completed or failed. A failed job is not a finished file; inspect its error before trying another generation. Avoid submitting duplicate jobs simply because a larger render is still processing.

<Frame><img src="https://chat.youniverse.ai/__l5e/assets-v1/f77d1fd8-b595-4fae-97ca-acd2aca4abb4/docs-studio-downloads.jpg" alt="Glass folder holding image, video and music with a download arrow" /></Frame>

## Filters and library actions

Filter by **All**, **Images**, **Videos** or **Audio**, then narrow with the available provider tabs (**All**, **ChatGPT**, **Gemini**, **Aura Sound**). Open images in the zoom/lightbox viewer. Use **Rename**, **Download** and **Delete**, including bulk deletion where available.

For music, open **View/Extract lyrics**, download lyrics as `.txt`, or choose **Edit song** to enter the song editor. **Use as reference** sends compatible media into Imagine.

## Download and manage
Inspect the file, then use the download action in the relevant viewer/workspace. Keep a local copy of important finished work. Imagine History supports search, pagination and selecting multiple items for deletion; review the selection before deleting.

Generated media uses access-controlled storage links. Do not treat a temporary playback or download link as a permanent public publishing address. [Storage and hosting](/builder/storage) explains the separate AI Builder file system; Studio media and an app's storage are not the same workspace.

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="Will a Remix overwrite the source?">Remix starts a new generation from earlier settings. Review the new result separately.</Accordion>
<Accordion title="Why is a previous media link no longer opening?">Access-controlled links may expire. Reopen the file from its library instead of using an old copied playback link.</Accordion>
<Accordion title="Does opening Media mean every Studio tool is unlocked?">No. Browsing a library and generating new media are separate actions. Pro or Elite is required for Studio generation controls.</Accordion>
  <Accordion title="Should I submit another job while my first render is processing?">
    Check its pending or processing status first. Larger creative jobs take time, and submitting again may create a duplicate. A failed status needs its error inspected; a completed status should have a file you can open.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
